current.location: Currently at Isle of Man Airport

warnings.heading: Yellow weather warning. Be aware: Frost and Ice
details: Adverse weather conditions are expected to affect the Island from 16:00 GMT on Friday 20th November 2026 to 09:00 GMT on Saturday 21st November 2026

Clear skies and light winds this evening will lead to temperatures quickly falling close to ZERO, or slightly below in some places, leading to a widespread frost, as well as a risk of ice on any damp/wet untreated surfaces.
warnings.areas: All areas at risk, however low-lying sheltered spots, as well as areas over higher ground will be at higher risk.

forecast: Clear spells this evening with a light and variable breeze, causing temperatures to fall close to 0°C for many parts of the island, but possibly down to -1°C for some places, leading to risk of frost and ice developing on any wet/damp untreated surfaces.
Remaining dry overnight as cloud cover increases along with the wind, allowing temperatures to recover later in the night.
Comments: Risk of frost and ice.

days.windComments: Variable 5-10 settling east or southeast 10-15 in the morning, then gradually increasing 20-30 later in the afternoon.
forecast: A cold start tomorrow with a risk of frost and ice in places.
A dry day ahead with sunny intervals, though getting breezier as the light or moderate southeasterly wind strengthens through the afternoon. Top temperature 10°C.
Comments: Risk of frost and ice at first. Strong winds developing.

days.windComments: Easterly 20-30, occasionally gusting 35-45 in places, gradually easing 10-15 later in the evening.
forecast: Dry with sunny spells on Sunday, turning cloudier later in the day, with a strong easterly wind easing through the afternoon, becoming moderate in the evening. Top temperature 9°C.
Comments: Risk of coastal overtopping (AM). Strong winds.

days.windComments: Easterly 15-20, veering southeast and gradually freshening, becoming 30-35 in the evening, possible with gusts 40-45 later.
days.visibility: Good, falling moderate in rain later.
forecast: Generally cloudy on Monday with a band of rain arriving later in the evening or overnight. Moderate to fresh easterly winds, veering southeast and gradually freshening, possibly reaching gale force overnight. Top temperature 10°C.
Comments: Strong winds developing, with a risk of gale force.

days.windComments: Southeast 35-45, veering southwest 10-15 in the afternoon, then backing easterly later.
days.visibility: Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Hill fog.
forecast: Occasional rain or showers on Tuesday, with a few sunny intervals in between. A strong southeast wind, possibly reaching gale force, then veering southwest and easing, backing easterly later. Top temperature 10°C.
Comments: Strong winds, with a risk of gale force. Heavy rain for a time.
